pipeline.description: Following the official artifact setup, the RAG retriever uses GTE-Qwen2-7B-Instruct served through an Ollama/GGUF F16 backend. The retrieved MITRE ATT&CK candidates are injected into the prompt of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, which performs the final TTP extraction.
